gaps.explanation: Proprietary statement p6: total operating revenues 244,395 (charges for services 228,780 + other operating revenues 15,615) + interest and investment revenue 1,210 = 245,605 (statement receipts). 'Non-operating grants' 32,389 (Water Fund) is printed below 'Income (loss) before transfers' and is recorded in business_type.other_financing, not in receipts. The Water Fund budgetary schedule p15 prints 'Grants' 32,389 among its revenues (detail line). Schedule revenue 136,856 + 7 + 15,104 + 32,389 (Water p15) + 91,924 + 1,203 + 511 (Sewer p16) = 277,994; 277,994 - 32,389 = 245,605 = statement. The whole gap of -32,389 is the grant, which the statement presents as a non-operating item outside receipts. Same money, presented differently; no line to add or remove.
